chunks: Yahya ibn Bashr al-Qanbari narrated, saying:
Abul Hasan (peace be upon him) made bequest to his son, Hasan (peace be upon him), four months before his passing, and he made me witness to that along with a group of the Mawali.

key_terms.الْمَوَالِي: the Mawali (freed slaves or their descendants, often companions)

ai.seo_question: Who witnessed the bequest of Imam al-Hadi to Imam al-Hasan al-Askari?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the formal designation (nass) of Imam al--Hasan al-Askari (a.s.) by his father, Imam al-Hadi (a.s.), four months before the latter's death, emphasizing the continuity of the Imamate during the period of minor occultation. The presence of Yahya ibn Bashr al-Qanbari and a group of Mawali as witnesses underscores the public and documented nature of this succession, reinforcing the Shia doctrine of divine appointment. This event is crucial for establishing the legitimacy of the eleventh Imam and serves as a foundational reference for the transition of authority within the Ahl al-Bayt.
